strategy.name: Tencent bounded baseline allocation
strategy.thesis: Tencent's gaming, advertising and Weixin ecosystem support cash generation and repurchases; the current plan's starter economics justify only bounded long-equity exposure because medium confidence, China policy and governance exposure, investment-portfolio volatility, artificial-intelligence spending and insufficient diversification prevent conviction treatment.
strategy.entry_rule: Open only while allocation_plan_0f41c211cdfa8a9b5dbc, allocation_intent_206644feb73549257619, assessment_6e8ef7291ff81b77d900 and relationship_f625ba3c07d49e1865ff remain current, fresh TCEHY and USD/EUR inputs are available, and deterministic code derives a positive whole-share delta toward the persisted three-share target.
strategy.exit_rule: Reduce or close only when a current deterministic allocation plan directs reduce or close, the starter eligibility frontier no longer clears, a hard blocker appears, or material gaming, advertising, Weixin, policy, governance, investment-portfolio or valuation evidence invalidates the bounded thesis.
strategy.invalidation: Do not increase exposure if gaming or advertising monetization weakens materially, Weixin engagement ceases to support commercial activity, policy or governance risk impairs shareholder economics, artificial-intelligence investment fails to convert into durable cash generation, portfolio-value volatility dominates operations, the assessment or relationship is superseded, or market and FX inputs become stale.
